fixer.title: Add Copilot plugin slash commands to Agent Host

introducer.title: Sessions: Add #file context completions to new-chat input

cases.mechanism: The generic implicit file completion provider treated slash-command argument text with no `#` variable as a file query, walking editor history and invoking workspace search (or recursively resolving virtual filesystem directories) whenever slash-command suggestions were retriggered.
cases.symptom: Slash-command argument completion could launch unrelated workspace file searches and delay/compete with the intended command suggestions on each incomplete completion refresh.
cases.fixedBehavior: The added slash-prefix guard returns before `_addFileAndFolderEntries`, preventing history traversal and the search/filesystem boundary unless the token is an explicit variable word.
cases.evidence: The fixed line now rejects implicit completion when text before the cursor begins with `/` and `range.varWord` is absent. The transitive old path immediately called `_addFileAndFolderEntries`, which always invokes `searchFilesAndFolders` for file/remote workspaces or recursively calls `fileService.resolve` for virtual workspaces. Agent-host command completion lists are marked incomplete and plugin choices explicitly retrigger suggestions, making this provider reachable repeatedly while typing slash arguments; the added regression test confirms this exact provider previously needed suppression for `/plugin `.
